**Conclusion:**  
Local tool-calling language models offer benefits like control, cost-efficiency, and privacy but face limitations in structured tool use, model variability, and evaluation challenges. Key findings include:  
1. **Benefits:** Local LLMs enable private, cost-effective deployments (Docker blog, Pure AI).  
2. **Limitations:** Tool-calling performance varies by model (Docker, 2026 blog); some models lack robust support (Hugging Face discussion).  
3. **Evaluation Gaps:** Current benchmarks may not reflect local server performance (2026 blog).  

**Key Findings with Sources:**  
- **Control & Privacy:** Local setups avoid cloud dependency, enhancing data privacy (Docker blog: [https://www.docker.com/blog/local-llm-tool-calling-a-practical-evaluation](https://www.docker.com/blog/local-llm-tool-calling-a-practical-evaluation)).  
- **Cost-Efficiency:** Lower costs compared to cloud alternatives (Pure AI: [https://pureai.com/articles/2025/09/02/pros-and-cons-of-running-a-large-language-model-locally.aspx](https://pureai.com/articles/2025/09/02/pros-and-cons-of-running-a-large-language-model-locally.aspx)).  
- **Tool-Calling Limitations:** Imperfect estimators and suboptimal cost-aware decisions in frameworks (ARXIV: [https://arxiv.org/html/2605.00737v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.00737v1)).  
- **Model Variability:** Qwen models outperform others in tool-calling tests (Docker blog: [https://www.docker.com/blog/local-llm-tool-calling-a-practical-evaluation](https://www.docker.com/blog/local-llm-tool-calling-a-practical-evaluation)).  
- **Evaluation Challenges:** Benchmarks may not reflect local server performance (2026 blog: [https://www.jdhodges.com/blog/local-llms-on-tool-calling-2026-pt1-local-lm](https://www.jdhodges.com/blog/local-llms-on-tool-calling-2026-pt1-local-lm)).  

**Limitations:** Some claims rely on specific models (e.g., Qwen) or frameworks (e.g., Ollama), which may not generalize to all local setups.
